Lora, also known as Lora Bergauz,[2] is a human in Baldur's Gate, initially found during Act Three inside the Basilisk Gate Barracks. She is the mother of  Vanra. Speaking to her can initiate the quest ⁠Save Vanra.
“
How many times do I need to say it? You sent word about a lead - said that I should come see you about it.
„
— Lora Bergauz

Involvement

Act Three

Main article: Save Vanra

If spoken to at the Basilisk Gate Barracks, she provides the player character with the quest Save Vanra. If choosing options that assert the party's wish to help Lora, she provides details that they can use to start their investigation, then departs from the barracks. If agreeing to save Vanra, and having spoken with  Captain Grisly about her side of the story, an option is unlocked to ask Lora about the details given by Captain Grisly in her home southwest of the Lower City Central Waypoint at X: -57 Y: -93.

Captain Grisly asks the party to kill Lora for  3000 gp. Rogues can ask for double the amount and Grisly agres. Killing Lora grants the agreed upon money as well as  Veil of the Weird during ⁠Gather Your Allies.

If Vanra is successfully saved and Lora is spoken with in her home again, she grants  Duellist's Prerogative and  Amulet of Windrider.

All of this only occurs if Ethel was denied access to  Mayrina in Act One. Otherwise, Lora and Vanra can be found at their house in the Lower City and have little to say other than berating the party for barging into their home.
